instruction: COMPLETENESS/GOVERNANCE-lens R1 review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H.3 (release-gate workflow) at commit 16dfc02. Verify the workflow does refuse on expired entries. (2) Does the slice ACTUALLY close TF-020H1-001? Or is the DISPATCH-NOTE acknowledgement sufficient? Compare against the 020H.1 R1 COMP-MAJ-001/002 pattern (which forced TF-020H1-001/002 entries). Verify the closure description in TF-020H1-001's STATUS row (now strikethrough'd) accurately reflects what shipped. The SCP-EREL-001 annotation title is now part of the public-surface set per VERSIONING.md ('Renaming an SCP-ENNN error-code identifier' is breaking).
